subject: Pricing disclosure workflow & NDA for Hosted API baseline
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudscale.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Cloudscale Legal <legal@cloudscale.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Intro + request for hosted API pricing / NDA

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking the meeting yesterday — Cloudscale is exploring hosted inference providers for a new vector search feature. Before we can share usage forecasts and sensitive telemetry needs with Procurement, Legal asked that we put an NDA in place.

Can you send your baseline hosted-API pricing (token and embedding tiers), any volume-tier discounts, and your standard mutual NDA (we can sign via DocuSign)? If possible, we prefer a PDF rate sheet and a clear version identifier so we can track changes on our side.

Also: are there any restrictions on benchmarking or POC data during a 30-day trial?

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Director, Product
Cloudscale Inc.
samir.patel@cloudscale.com
+1 415-555-0189

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudscale.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request for hosted API pricing / NDA

Hi Samir — great to meet you too.

We can absolutely proceed that way. Attached is a one-way NDA template for initial review and a DocuSign link if you want to sign electronically. Once we have an executed NDA, I will share the current baseline pricing PDF (we maintain a versioned rate sheet; I'll send the v1.3 file and include a short changelog).

Summary of next steps from our side:
- Please sign the NDA: https://www.docusign.com/signed/abc123 (or attach a countersigned copy).
- After countersignature, I'll email Redwood_Hosted_API_Pricing_v1.3.pdf and a short internal note on negotiable line items (discounts, commitment tiers, and billing currency).
- We can schedule a short follow-up to walk the rate table and proposed billing cadence.

Regarding POCs: we generally allow benchmarking but ask that any benchmarking data collection follow our data-processing addendum. I can include the POC guardrails in the pricing doc.

Attachment: Redwood_NDA_RedwoodOneway_v2.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Sales Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0147

We returned the NDA as: Cloudscale_NDA_signed_20270416.pdf (attached). DocuSign reference: https://www.docusign.com/signed/abc123

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudscale.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + request for hosted API pricing / NDA

Samir — appreciate the quick turnaround and for returning the signed NDA. Confirmed receipt of Cloudscale_NDA_signed_20270416.pdf.

Sharing the baseline pricing doc as requested: Redwood_Hosted_API_Pricing_v1.3.pdf (attached). Highlights and notes (version 1.3):
- Baseline tiers: Free trial (250k tokens + 5000 embeddings), Pay-as-you-go, Standard monthly commitment, Enterprise reserved capacity. Pricing table included on page 2.
- Discounting: standard early-stage (startup) discount is 10% off list for first 12 months; enterprise volume discounts start at 15% for 1M tokens/mo committed. Any one-off promotional discounts require manager approval (cc'd: lauren_bishop).
- Billing: USD by default; we can invoice EUR for EU legal entities but that affects payment terms.
- Version control: filename includes version (v1.3) and changelog on page 1. If we update after negotiation, we'll label v1.4 and include a timestamp and changelog entry.
- POC/benchmarking: allowed under the NDA with required redaction of PII and a short data-processing addendum (included as Appendix A in the PDF).

Suggested next step: 30-minute walkthrough next week to go line-by-line. Proposed slots: Tue/Wed 10–12 PT. Pick one and I'll calendar.

Attachments:
- Redwood_Hosted_API_Pricing_v1.3.pdf (PDF, 132KB)
- Pricing_Internal_Notes_v1.docx (DOCX, internal, 24KB) — internal commentary on negotiable items (please do not forward).

Looking forward —
Tessa
Sr. Sales Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
